name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... Chaos... The unpredictability of existence. A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered. We would not be here today without them.
Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors. Embrace the madness!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Seek the madness from within Zul'Gurub and overshadow it with your own, friend! To do so means success, and success means reward! Let not the Blood God reign supreme again!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend... Your accomplishments in Zul'Gurub have earned you the right to call the Zandalar tribe as a friend. I will see to the disposition of the Paragons; for your effort please accept this reward!
